items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: If you’re ok with it, I think it’s a singular opportunity to go over some of these lyrics with you.
Well, this one, “My Back Yard,” Mose used to, at some time during every day, sit in the back yard. I called him “Little Buddha.”
there’s a nice photo of you sitting in the back yard with a book. Your legs are crossed, you’re reading a book, you have a hat on...
